open_items: GAP SPEC, filed 2026-07-16 (operator 2026-07-15 night): staged remediation — restore service (bounded/reversible) -> investigate (read-mostly, FailureFinding binds diagnosis to evidence) -> prevent recurrence (classified paths only), EACH stage its own grant, EACH transition demands the prior stage's witness (RecoveryReceipt / FailureFinding / DeploymentReceipt). 'Permission to restart the service' must not become 'permission to rewrite the scheduler' — anti-laundering by TYPE (origin-fence idiom, R4-adjacent). Restoration success is typed apart from diagnosis; RESOLVED-at-stage-1 (recovered, cause not established) is a LEGAL terminal. Census: ops IncidentStatus FSM is bookkeeping not authority; phase_control/scope ladder/deployment profiles/S7 containment all exist; missing = stage-typed grants + transition-witness minting. Completes the constellation split: Maude=how, AG=whether, Nightshift=execute+receipts (this is Nightshift's missing standing-delegation layer), NQ=novelty escape hatch. NOTHING ARMED. 4 OQs incl. where stage grants live (LA/standing/ration — provider choice mutates admissibility basis) and who may sign a FailureFinding.
